ref_name.description: The ref to check out (branch, tag, or commit). Defaults to the remote's default branch when `None`.

url.description: The remote URL to clone. Must match an entry in the runtime's `source_import_allowlist` (prefix match — see the dispatcher's note for the semantics). 1.1.G only supports `file://` URLs in practice; HTTPS / SSH URLs are reachable through the same code path but the §97 gate does not test them (the test fixture is a local bare repo).

workspace_handle.description: The handle directory the runtime created or reused for `job_id`. The caller uses this to drive `candidate.capture` next.
